title: Yellowed Snappy Turkish Saskatoon Berries Mercimek Corbasi
description: A festive and diabetic-friendly Turkish dish featuring roasted Saskatoon berries and mercimek corbasi, a traditional Turkish red lentil soup, with a snappy texture from mushimono-steam cooking. This dish is perfect for a special occasion or holiday meal.
instructions: Rinse the red lentils and drain well.
In a large pot, saute the chopped onion, minced garlic, chopped carrots, and chopped celery in olive oil until the vegetables are tender.
Add the red lentils, tomato paste, salt, and black pepper to the pot and stir well.
Add 4 cups of water to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes or until the lentils are tender.
While the lentils are cooking, roast the Saskatoon berries in a 400 degree oven for 15 minutes or until they are tender and lightly browned.
Mushimono-steam the roasted Saskatoon berries for 5 minutes or until they are snappy and tender.
Stir the steamed Saskatoon berries into the cooked lentils and serve hot.
